verdicts.reason: A keeps the original order (eyebrow, headline, body, bottle in circle, CTA) with a clean shared left edge and the circle contained behind the bottle. Flaws: a slightly large gap before the CTA, and the CTA is left-aligned while the bottle is centered. B moves 'WEEKEND ONLY' below the body copy, breaking reading order. Its circle overlaps the headline and text, and the CTA is centered while the text is left-aligned, so the layout looks jumbled.
